name: Cloudflare Agentic Inbox
description: Email management via the Cloudflare Agentic Inbox REST API. Provides tools to list mailboxes, read/send/reply/delete emails.
brief: You can manage emails via the Cloudflare Agentic Inbox using the `agentic_inbox` skill. Load it with `use_skill('agentic_inbox')` to list mailboxes, read emails, send replies, and more.
author: Evonic

variables.name: WORKER_URL
variables.label: Worker URL
variables.description: Base URL of the deployed Cloudflare Agentic Inbox Worker (e.g. https://inbox.evonic.dev). Do NOT include a trailing slash.

variables.name: ACCESS_TOKEN
variables.label: Access Token
variables.description: Cloudflare Access JWT (from CF_Authorization cookie after browser login, or a service-token-derived JWT). Sent as the cf-access-jwt-assertion header to authenticate against the Worker.
